contexts.name: Candidate Profile Builder
contexts.description: Guided intake for archetype-aware CandidateProfileV2 profiles, where skills and evidence carry provenance. Spans the Profile editor, candidate matrix, archetype manager, and completeness follow-up UI, the /api/profile, candidates, draft and archetypes routes, and Python profile/seed/AI-draft CLIs over a shared archetypes.json registry.

contexts.name: Scoring & Extraction Engine (Python)
contexts.description: The deterministic Python core that parses CVs (PDF/DOCX), extracts a profile, and scores job fit, salary band, soft signals, transferable skills and potential, with optional Gemini narrative and embedding bridge. Covers the pipeline/service/CLIs, taxonomy, archetype routing, i18n, weight proposals, and TS salary-band helper.

contexts.name: Analysis Results & Reporting
contexts.description: Renders saved CV analyses: the tabbed ResultPanel (extraction, job fit, salary, interview, compare), score dials/badges, archetype banner, soft-signals and potential panels, quality/trust-ledger strip, disposition editor and report share/export. Backed by /api/analyses routes, the history view, comparison/sanity-check libs and a seed script.

contexts.name: CV Analysis Workspace
contexts.description: Upload or paste a CV and a job description, then run an AI job-fit analysis with live scan progress. The primary intake surface (Analyze tab) for evaluating a single candidate against a role.

contexts.name: Job Catalog, Ingestion & Sourcing
contexts.description: Manages the job catalog and its draft-publish-close lifecycle: authoring, pasted-ad ingestion (Claude CLI parse, content-hash dedup) into matchable Job rows, and the recruiter-facing inverse ranking of a shared candidate pool. Surfaces the Jobs tab/table, posting modal, campaign ad-copy generation, talent rediscovery, and one-click outreach.

contexts.name: JD Library & Builder
contexts.description: Create, AI-generate, template and store job descriptions; browse the JD library and render public JD pages. Saved JDs are reusable inputs for analysis and matching.

contexts.name: Decision Workflow & Group Eval
contexts.description: Drives hiring decisions per role: a configurable screening wave (auto-reject the worst-fit cohort with fairness gates and audited rationales) and an LLM comparative group evaluation that ranks candidates with a cross-scheme fairness matrix, unique-strength differentiators, and risks. Surfaces the Decisions tab, group-eval modal subviews, and decision analytics.

contexts.name: Candidate-Job Matching & Fit Matrix
contexts.description: Scores one candidate against many jobs via the layered Python engine (KO gates, multi-factor weighted scoring, cached LLM reasoning) and renders a candidate-by-role fit matrix with per-column distribution stats. Surfaces the Match and Matrix tabs, adjustable weights panel, job-for-candidate compare, and reasoning cache keying/policy.

contexts.name: Interview Prep & Rubric
contexts.description: Generate per-candidate interview prep guides and scoring rubrics, and open prep / transcript modals from the schedule surface.

contexts.name: Voice Interview Runtime
contexts.description: Runs AI-conducted first-round voice screens via pluggable OpenAI Realtime and ElevenLabs adapters. Covers the candidate token page, interview-lab harness and recruiter simulator, create/connect/complete/revoke routes, server-enforced consent and capability preflight, plus case-grounded/student briefs, transcript-to-scorecard synthesis and call telemetry.

contexts.name: Scheduling & Offers
contexts.description: Send interview-schedule invites and offer links via public token pages, let candidates pick slots, finalize offers and dispatch reminders.

contexts.name: Pipeline Board & Scheduler
contexts.description: Drag-and-drop recruitment board over the 5-stage funnel (Accepted-Hired) with a candidate drawer, Today rail and unified timeline. The scheduler atomically claims due runs and triggers the shared automation pass; approval-kind routing flags entries needing a human, and a cursor-based events feed streams activity without dropping bursts.

contexts.name: Dev Case Python Engine
contexts.description: Python pipeline that designs LLM-era take-home cases grading durable skills over code: need analysis, role/case design, materialized seed repos, sourcing, submission and interview evaluation with shared LLM-judge and provenance/confidence envelopes. Includes lifecycle/submission health evals and a separate golden-set eval harness (extraction, matching, automation fairness).

contexts.name: Dev Case Orchestration & API
contexts.description: Server orchestration for the developer take-home pipeline — API routes for design/source/submit/publish/promote/lifecycle, plus the orchestrator, autonomy control gating and outcome calibration store.

contexts.name: Dev Case Studio (UI)
contexts.description: Recruiter-facing workspace for the automated developer take-home flow: define needs, generate/publish postings, review submissions, run evals, and walk cases through their lifecycle with an autonomy control panel.

contexts.name: Demo Simulation & Channels
contexts.description: Drives the guided product demo: a SimulationProvider walks a scripted Design to Hired run with spotlights, group-eval and decision-wave frames, plus a marker-keyed sim reset. Also owns real candidate comms — the inbound lead-intake core, locale-pinned dispatch, channel webhooks, and the Channels/Outbox UI.

contexts.name: Automation Orchestration
contexts.description: Run the end-to-end automated recruiting pipeline as scheduled or triggered passes — execute per-task automation, schedule runs and surface automation status across the funnel.

contexts.name: GitHub Code Analysis
contexts.description: Analyze a candidate's GitHub repositories — snapshot a repo and produce an AI code/skills assessment surfaced in a dedicated analysis panel.

contexts.name: Conversational Apply
contexts.description: The candidate-facing application experience reached via a token link — a conversational apply flow that captures the applicant and feeds them into the recruiting pipeline.

contexts.name: Analytics & Diagrams
contexts.description: Renders the hiring funnel analytics (conversion, time-to-hire, bottleneck, momentum, per-source spend economics) and an audited decision log with CSV export. Includes the About coverage tour and a bespoke SVG PlantUML renderer (ELK layout) powering the interactive pipeline diagram explorer.

contexts.name: Workspace Shell & Shared UI
contexts.description: App shell, root layout/page, and the studio sidebar nav with its single-source tab/deep-link registry. Holds command palette, keyboard shortcuts, recents and attention tracking; i18n (next-intl locales/server/request) and theming/reduced-motion; the marketing landing/spark pages; OG image gen; plus shared UI primitives (Badge, Modal, Markdown, Skeleton, icons) and lib helpers (api-response, rate-limit, safe-url, loaders).

contexts.name: Data Layer, Schemas & Python Bridge
contexts.description: SQLite layer: better-sqlite3 core (schema, seeding, seed-health) and per-domain repositories (jobs, profiles, analyses, pipeline, interviews, channels, billing, llm, devcase, tasks). Covers the cache, python-runner spawn bridge with typed PipelineError, codegen of generated Zod schemas/taxonomy from Pydantic, background tasks queue/API, workspace export/import (db portability), ops/JSONL telemetry, health, env and instrumentation.

contexts.name: Billing & Entitlements
contexts.description: Subscription billing and plan entitlements via Polar — checkout/portal/webhook routes, entitlement enforcement, plan definitions, usage reduction and account sync.

contexts.name: LLM Settings & Model Config
contexts.description: Recruiter-facing LLM configuration — pick providers and models, store/encrypt API keys, and run a connectivity canary. Backs the Models settings tab and the /api/llm config/keys/test routes.

contexts.name: LLM Provider Layer (Python)
contexts.description: Multi-provider LLM abstraction for the Python job-fit pipeline — provider adapters (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini), a capability/registry/config layer, a runtime monitor, and a benchmarking harness that scores models against scenario contracts.
